args.title: Use configured application base URL for password reset email link
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use the configured application base URL from config instead of process.env.PUBLIC_URL (or fall back to the config service rather than a hardcoded localhost URL) so that password reset email links point to the correct production domain.
